When the user asks to compare years or groups without asking for a change, keep those year/group columns and requested measures in the output.

Quote column names with double quotes when they contain spaces or odd characters. When two tables describe the same thing with different column names, UNION ALL them with aligned aliases.

CURRENT QUESTION:
compare average daily attendance rate per centre across the two years, one row each
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH attendance_data AS (
  SELECT 
    "Centre" AS centre,
    "Avg Daily Present" AS daily_present,
    "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled,
    2023 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2023"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    "centre_name" AS centre,
    "average_attendance" AS daily_present,
    "enrolment" AS enrolled,
    2024 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2024"
)
SELECT 
  centre,
  AVG(CAST(daily_present AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(enrolled, 0)) * 100 AS avg_attendance_rate_2023,
  AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN CAST(daily_present AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(enrolled, 0) * 100 END) AS avg_attendance_rate_2024
FROM attendance_data
GROUP BY centre;
```
